title: The Rocky Horror Picture Show
about: A stranded couple find shelter in a castle run by a flamboyant mad scientist from outer space.
cue: Serve the toast when Frank proposes one at dinner.
faces: COVER AT THE DOOR, NO DRESS CODE
“Brad, Janet, you'll stay the night. Dinner is ready, and so is the laboratory.”
Fried custard bread fingers rolled in cinnamon sugar, maple syrup to dip.
Mini hot dogs simmered in a sweet tomato and mustard glaze.
Beef and pork meatloaf with a tomato and brown sugar glaze.
Two-layer butter cake with whipped cream filling, buttercream and edible gold.
Vodka, orange liqueur, cranberry and lime with a flamed orange peel.
